additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Data Processing architectures for building AI solutions | ANT305
additionalFields.bodyBack: Prepare to revolutionize your data infrastructure for the AI era with Amazon EMR, AWS Glue, and Amazon Athena. This session guides you through leveraging these powerful AWS services to construct robust, scalable data architectures that empower AI solutions at scale. Gain insights into effective architectural strategies for data processing, optimizing for cost-efficiency and security. Explore frameworks that underpin successful AI-driven data initiatives, and learn field lessons on navigating modernization projects. Whether you're starting your modernization journey or refining current setups, this session offers practical strategies to fast-track your organization toward achieving excellence in AI-powered data management.

additionalFields.heading: Lightning talk
additionalFields.title: Agentic AI for Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) (sponsored by Accenture) | PRTNaN-S
additionalFields.bodyBack: From Autonomous Networks to Enterprise-Scale Reliability — How Agentic AI is Reinventing the SRE Lifecycle

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: SageMaker & MLflow: Innovate faster with no infrastructure management | AIM308
additionalFields.bodyBack: Production LLM applications fail in ways pre-launch rubrics miss: dropped context, hallucinated citations, mistimed tool calls. Evaluation-Driven Development (EDD) treats eval as an operational practice, not an after-the-fact report. Using a conversational RAG agent on Amazon Bedrock and Amazon SageMaker AI managed MLflow 3.10, we walk through EDD end-to-end: define criteria, build datasets, iterate with evaluate(), monitor production with scheduled scorers, and feed failures back.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Accelerate ISV development with Kiro's spec-driven AI agents | SEG302
additionalFields.bodyBack: ISVs building agentic AI platforms face the challenge of moving from idea to production without sacrificing engineering rigor. This session explores how Kiro, an agentic IDE, enables spec-driven development that helps teams delegate and automate complex tasks through intelligent agents. Attendees discover how Kiro's agents work alongside developers to solve hard engineering problems with confidence. Hear from Clickatell, a chat commerce ISV, on how they use Kiro to accelerate development of their agentic AI platform on AWS.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Streamline AI model development lifecycle with Amazon SageMaker AI | AIM304
additionalFields.bodyBack: Discover how the BMW Group's Vision and Sound Analytics Service (VSAS) processes 1.3 million images and audio files daily across 16 production sites, turning 1.3 PB of data into AI-powered insights. Learn how SageMaker AI underpins computer vision models for predictive maintenance and rail-failure detection, and powers a self-service acoustic analytics model builder that lets users train custom noise-detection models for engine performance and in-cabin comfort. With SageMaker training instances cutting model training from days to hours and scalable inference at the core, BMW ZA dedicates 80–90% of resources to innovation.

additionalFields.heading: Lightning talk
additionalFields.title: Building Your First Cloud Portfolio Project Using AWS Free Tier | STU106
additionalFields.location: Student Builder Zone UpLink, Hall 2, Floor 0
additionalFields.bodyBack: Most computer science students know how to code, but few know how to deploy it. This session helps IT students bridge that gap by turning class projects into professional portfolio pieces using AWS Free Tier. We explain what is actually free, how cloud deployment works, and how to frame your project to catch the eye of recruiters and applicant tracking systems. You will leave with a clear, actionable plan to build a project, host it live, and add it to your CV, even without prior cloud experience.

additionalFields.heading: Lightning talk
additionalFields.title: Amazon's Leadership Principles for Students | STU110
additionalFields.location: Student Builder Zone UpLink, Hall 2, Floor 0
additionalFields.bodyBack: Amazon's Leadership Principles aren't just corporate values - they're a practical framework for how you think, decide, and grow. In this lightning talk, Petra Neilon (Recruitment Manager, AWS) picks the most relevant principles and shows how you can apply them right now: in your studies, side projects, and career decisions. Expect relatable examples and practical takeaways.

additionalFields.heading: Workshop
additionalFields.title: From Zero to Agent with Kiro | AIM302
additionalFields.bodyBack: Kiro CLI gets more powerful once its agents, MCP servers, steering files, and skills are configured well, but doing that by hand is error-prone. In this hands-on workshop you'll use Config Control for Kiro, an interactive UI, to build and govern a multi-agent system: spin up agents, wire MCP servers and tools, author steering files and skills, and manage global versus project-level workspaces, with the editor and JSON in sync. To prove it works, you'll configure a set of agents that build and run a small playable arcade game, leaving you able to maintain multi-agent Kiro setups of your own.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: From Cloud Bills to Business Value: Unit Economics for a GoTyme | COP302
additionalFields.bodyBack: In this session, discover how a leading financial services group moved beyond traditional FinOps to build a cost intelligence platform that maps cloud spend to real business outcomes. Learn how they measure cost-to-serve per transaction, per client, and per banking product — integrating platform costs, tooling costs, and efficiency ratios into a single view across multiple entities. We'll also cover how AWS Marketplace became their mechanism for standardised global procurement, and share practical lessons for anyone looking to connect cloud investment to unit economics at scale.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Beyond SaaS: How software companies thrive in the Autonomous AI era | SEG303
additionalFields.bodyBack: In one week of February 2026, the software sector lost roughly a trillion dollars in market cap — not from a better competitor, but because autonomous agents began dissolving jobs traditionally done by SaaS vendors. This session offers software companies a new mental model for the agentic era and one diagnostic to run on their business. We'll explore six surfaces where coding agents now decide whether your product gets used, examine emerging business models for autonomous AI — including challenges around security, distribution, and monetization — and close with how the teams building all of this are starting to look.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: AI-Powered RDS/Aurora MySQL/PostgreSQL Database Management | DAT307
additionalFields.bodyBack: AI changed how we write code. Now it's changing how we manage databases. This session explores the full spectrum — from Aurora and RDS's native AI-driven tuning and diagnostics, to agentic coding tools that help DBAs write optimised queries, generate infrastructure-as-code, and build self-healing automation. Whether you run MySQL, PostgreSQL, or both, you'll see how AI assistants and agentic workflows are compressing hours of DBA toil into minutes of guided, intelligent action.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Build a well-architected foundation for scaling GenAI and agentic apps | ARC304
additionalFields.bodyBack: Generative AI and agentic applications promise business transformation, but moving from prototype to production at scale exposes gaps in architecture, security, and operations. In this session, learn how to apply Well-Architected principles to build a reliable foundation for GenAI and agentic workloads on AWS. We cover gateway design, orchestration, observability, guardrails, and cost governance using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and Strands Agents. Through real customer patterns, see how to avoid common pitfalls, standardize shared services across business units, and accelerate safe adoption. Leave with a reference architecture and checklist you can apply to your next GenAI initiative.

additionalFields.heading: Gamified learning
additionalFields.title: Hackathon: From Idea to MVP with Agentic AI | AIM205
additionalFields.bodyBack: A hands-on hackathon where participants use Kiro to ideate, build, and present AI-powered solutions. Teams will be introduced to Kiro's development spectrum, set up their environments, and spend two hours building a working prototype. The session concludes with team presentations — a 1–2 slide pitch (generated via Amazon Quick) covering value, impact, and future roadmap, alongside a live product demo. Judged on quality, innovation, execution, and presentation.

additionalFields.heading: Lightning talk
additionalFields.title: Before You Build: Product Management Moves That Make Agentic AI Stick (Sponsored by Deloitte) | PRT203-S
additionalFields.bodyBack:
Gartner predicts more than 40% of agentic AI projects will be cancelled by 2027 — not because the technology falls short, but because of escalating costs, unclear business value, and inadequate risk controls. These are product management gaps, and they’re solvable. 
 
Across multiple agentic AI assessments and deliveries in Financial Services, Telco, and Mining, I’ve seen the same pattern: organisations that define value before they build, model costs before they demo, and name an owner before the POC ends are the ones that make it to production and stay there. You’ll leave with the questions that make that difference.

additionalFields.heading: Startup talk
additionalFields.title: Idea to Income: Designing, Pricing, and Scaling GenAI Products | STP202
additionalFields.bodyBack: Generative AI is the largest disruption to software company business models since the emergence of SaaS. In this session we'll cover best practices software companies use to take AI-native products from pilot to production, including identifying use cases that drive business value, features that accelerate adoption and pricing strategies that result in profitable growth

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Aspen's 60-Day VMware Exit with AWS Agentic AI | CMP201
additionalFields.bodyBack: Aspen Pharmacare - one of Africa's largest pharmaceutical manufacturers and a global healthcare leader - faced rising VMware licensing costs following Broadcom's acquisition and needed to move fast, without compromising strict regulatory requirements. See how AWS and Deloitte helped Aspen exit VMware to Amazon EC2 in under two months, powered end‑to‑end by AWS agentic AI. AWS Transform's AI agents accelerated workload assessment and automated migration‑wave planning, while governed AI agents built with Kiro helped migrate, test, and now operate the estate. The result: substantial cost savings and a secure, Well‑Architected foundation, with regulatory adherence throughout.

additionalFields.heading: Lightning talk
additionalFields.title: UNISA Scales Moodle to 30 000+ Concurrent Exam Students on AWS (Sponsored by Silicon Overdrive) | PRT208-S
additionalFields.bodyBack: The University of South Africa (UNISA), Africa's largest open distance e-learning institution serving over 340,000 students, migrated its nine-instance Moodle platform from Microsoft Azure to AWS in the Africa (Cape Town) Region. Delivered in four months under the AWS Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) by Silicon Overdrive, Human Logic, and MpiloTech, the project transformed UNISA's ability to support national scale online examinations. The new infrastructure sustains 30,000+ concurrent students during exam windows, validated at a 99.99994% success rate and 163 millisecond median response time at 28,000 concurrent users, establishing UNISA as one of the largest concurrent Moodle deployments globally.

additionalFields.heading: Chalk talk
additionalFields.title: Inside AWS EC2: Failure and recovery at scale | COP203
additionalFields.bodyBack: Anyone who ships production code will, on a long enough timeline, become a connoisseur of failure. This is doubly true in complex systems at scale. From inside AWS, EC2 engineers from Cape Town will lead this session, sharing some of the real lessons learned at scale, realtime discovery of new failure modes (congestive collapse) in production and how we work toward recovery at pace to protect our customers.

additionalFields.heading: Lightning talk
additionalFields.title: Simplifying service management with Smart Desk (sponsored by MFactory) | PRT101-S
additionalFields.bodyBack: Join this session to discover how organisations can replace fragmented spreadsheets, emails and manual service-management processes with a centralised cloud-based approach. See how MFactory developed Smart Desk on AWS to bring incidents, service requests, assets, SLA tracking and operational reporting into one platform. Learn practical lessons for improving service visibility, accountability and decision-making through cloud-enabled service management.

additionalFields.heading: Workshop
additionalFields.title: Create your own role-playing game with Agentic AI using Strands Agents | STU301
additionalFields.location: Student Builder Zone Workshop, Hall 2, Floor 0
additionalFields.bodyBack: Come code a Dungeons and Dragons (DnD) AI Game Master that will be responsible for orchestrating multiple AI agents, each specialized in a particular task. We'll explore concepts such as agent tools, the MCP protocol (Model Context Protocol), A2A (agent to agent), and RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) to create agents and/or MCP servers that roll dice, verify DnD rules, and generate the story as it unfolds. Whether you're a role-playing game fan or not, there will be things to learn during this workshop.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: How Aerobotics Grades Millions of Fruit with Computer Vision on AWS | SEG201
additionalFields.bodyBack: Commercial fruit growers have long relied on manual sampling covering less than 1% of orchards, resulting in incomplete data that drives inefficient harvest planning, preventable waste, and unmeasured yield losses. This session explores how Aerobotics built an automated grading system on AWS combining drone surveys, in-field mobile tracking, and packshed intake grading to deliver full orchard visibility. In 2026 alone, Aerobotics' AWS infrastructure has processed 120 million fruit and 26 million trees across 29+ countries. Learn how the team operates at production scale at 99.9% uptime, enabling growers to make data-driven harvest and sales decisions.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: From tech debt to competitive advantage: Migrate & modernize with AWS | MAM202
additionalFields.bodyBack:
Your legacy applications and infrastructure don't have to be a liability. In this session, discover how leading enterprises are converting tech debt into modern cloud advantages that unlock AI capabilities, cut costs, and accelerate innovation.

The path to AI starts with migration and modernization. We'll walk through the complete transformation journey: infrastructure, applications, data, and AI-ready business outcomes. You'll see how new agentic AI automation is making migration and modernization faster, simpler, and more cost-effective. We'll explore proven pathways for your most critical workloads (Microsoft, VMware, SAP, and mainframe), backed by 20 years of AWS expertise."

additionalFields.heading: Workshop
additionalFields.title: Troubleshooting in the cloud with Kiro CLI | AIM303
additionalFields.bodyBack: Learn how to troubleshoot large-scale AWS environments through an AI-first approach powered by Kiro CLI. We’ll begin with hands-on experience using Kiro CLI’s custom AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration, demonstrating how AI transforms traditional problem-solving through contextual, automated diagnostics. The AI agents are also complemented with essential tools, including log and metrics analysis through Amazon CloudWatch, AWS Config, and AWS X-Ray. Choose your preferred domain- networking, containers, databases, or serverless/DevOps - and work on triaging real-world issues using Agentic AI and the best practices shared during the workshop. You must bring your laptop to participate.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: CV to Interview: Navigating Tech Recruitment | STU206
additionalFields.location: Student Builder Zone Track, Hall 2, Floor 0
additionalFields.bodyBack: This session equips you with practical strategies and proven frameworks to navigate the tech recruitment process - from identifying the right opportunities, to landing the interview.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Building an AI-powered database proxy for real-time query optimization | DAT304
additionalFields.bodyBack: Managing database security and performance across production workloads is complex — especially when sensitive data flows through every query. Capitec Bank built an intelligent database proxy that intercepts pgwire traffic to analyse, optimise, and govern SQL queries in real time using Amazon Bedrock. In this session, learn how Capitec uses LLM-powered query inspection with prepared statement caching and Valkey to deliver real-time PII detection, query optimisation, and A/B load balancing across Aurora PostgreSQL and Amazon Redshift. Discover how this architecture enables production-grade data governance without application changes — turning your database layer into an intelligent security boundary.

additionalFields.heading: Lightning talk
additionalFields.title: Announcement | STU111
additionalFields.location: Student Builder Zone UpLink, Hall 2, Floor 0
additionalFields.bodyBack: What happens when you combine the energy of sport, the mission of social impact, and a fresh approach to learning? Something powerful — and it’s here.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: The Platform Effect: Standard Bank's migration to the Future | MAM201
additionalFields.bodyBack: This session reveals how Africa's largest financial services group approached digital transformation differently — by deliberately investing in platform foundations that would compound into lasting competitive advantage. AWS opens with the digital transformation imperative: how customers leverage AI-driven solutions to accelerate beyond traditional migration toward transformation excellence. Standard Bank then shares their lived experience of a "Secure Foundation First" philosophy: from establishing a locked-down AWS Landing Zone to large-scale cloud migration and accelerating data and AI at enterprise scale.

additionalFields.heading: Chalk talk
additionalFields.title: Building AI-Powered Troubleshooting Skills for Cloud Support Engineers | COP303
additionalFields.bodyBack: Cloud support engineers spend significant time navigating static SOPs and switching between diagnostic tools. This chalk talk explores how to build AI-powered troubleshooting skills using Kiro or Claude and MCP servers that transform traditional runbooks into interactive, context-aware agents. Through whiteboarding, we'll design skill architectures that integrate CloudWatch, Athena, and service-specific APIs into agentic workflows. Learn how to author SOPs that AI agents can execute, implement domain-specific troubleshooting patterns for complex services, and measure impact through resolution time and accuracy metrics. Bring your troubleshooting challenges for collaborative problem-solving.

additionalFields.heading: Startup talk
additionalFields.title: Why Africa's AI Startups Are Uninvestable — Until They're Unstoppable | STP101
additionalFields.bodyBack:
Africa's AI market is projected to grow from $4.5B to $16.5B in five years, with AI unlocking up to $103B in economic value. Yet the continent captured just 0.03% of global AI startup funding in Q3 2025.

This panel brings together Africa-focused investors and a breakthrough AI founder to discuss what's working, what's broken, and what's next — covering defensibility through data, language, and distribution moats, and how infrastructure partnerships turn scale into a competitive edge.

AWS gives African startups access to NVIDIA GPUs, Anthropic's Claude, 100+ foundation models, and the ability to scale across 54 regulatory environments.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Sovereign AI on AWS: Cloud Operations from Zero Data to Production | COP202
additionalFields.bodyBack: Rwanda's 14 million Kinyarwanda speakers were locked out of AI-powered services because no commercial system supported their language. The Ministry of ICT partnered with Digital Umuganda to build custom language models on AWS from near-zero training data. Community partners crowdsourced diverse datasets, and the team built four production models — an LLM, machine translation, speech recognition, and speech synthesis — on EC2 and S3 infrastructure. Deployed first to 58,000 Community Health Workers, diagnostic accuracy jumped from 8% to 71%. This session explores building AI where no training data exists and the government-startup-cloud partnership that made it possible.

additionalFields.heading: Workshop
additionalFields.title: Modernize .NET apps for Linux using AWS Transform and Kiro | AIM402
additionalFields.bodyBack: Still tied to .NET Framework on Windows Server? In this hands-on workshop you'll take a real .NET Framework 4.8 Web Forms application and modernize it to cross-platform .NET 10 - in a fraction of the usual time. You'll drive AWS Transform for .NET, an agentic-AI modernization service that automates the heavy lifting of code transformation, then use Kiro, an AI-powered IDE, to close the residual gaps and verify the result. Together they form an end-to-end modernization accelerator that takes you from a legacy Windows dependency to a Linux-ready application - with confidence in what ships.

additionalFields.heading: Chalk talk
additionalFields.title: Building Multi-Tenant RAG and MCP Servers | ARC301
additionalFields.bodyBack: Multi-tenancy introduces unique challenges when integrating RAG and MCP servers into GenAI architectures. Tenant context directly influences how we reference resources that refine AI outputs. This chalk talk explores key design decisions: Should you deploy per-tenant RAG and MCP servers? How do you route requests to the right tenant resources? What are the implications for tenant onboarding and isolation? We’ll walk through practical patterns for representing and integrating these servers in a multi-tenant experience, addressing trade-offs between shared and dedicated infrastructure.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Automate any business process using Amazon Quick | IND204
additionalFields.bodyBack: Discover how to automate any business process using Amazon Quick Flows and Amazon Quick Automate, empowering every user in your organization to safely leverage agentic AI. Learn from real-world success stories as companies like Kenya Airways use Amazon Quick Suite to save time and money while improving customer outcomes. Hear directly from Kenya Airways as they share their automation success story leveraging Amazon Quick's automation capabilities, key insights, and vision for scaling automation enterprise-wide. Walk away with practical insights for implementing agentic automations to transform how you and your teams work.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Accelerate Your Cloud Journey with AWS Transform | TNC202
additionalFields.bodyBack: Embark on a faster, smoother cloud transformation with agentic AI and integrated solutions. This session reveals how AWS Transform accelerates your cloud journey, addressing migration and modernization challenges through intelligent automation. Through real-world examples, discover how to leverage this powerful integration to fast-track your cloud adoption and transformation efforts. With the specialized AI agents of AWS Transform, customers can migrate VMware workloads to Amazon EC2, modernize .NET applications to cross-platform .NET, and modernize IBM z/OS mainframe applications, delivering transformation projects up to 4x faster.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Navigating the future: Solutions architecture in the age of AI | ARC302
additionalFields.bodyBack: Many organisations can experiment with AI—few can scale it. The difference lies in architecture. This session explores how the architect's role is evolving from system designer to orchestrator of production-grade AI solutions. Learn how architects bridge the gap between promising prototypes and enterprise reality—aligning use cases to business value, designing scalable patterns, embedding governance and ensuring operational excellence.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Explore the Agentic Capabilities of Amazon Quick | TNC201
additionalFields.bodyBack: In this breakout session, discover the latest features of Amazon Quick, a generative AI-powered business intelligence platform transforming organizational data workflows. Explore the newest capabilities including Quick Sight for interactive visualizations, Quick Flows for workflow creation, Quick Automate for intelligent automation, and Quick Research for comprehensive analysis. Learn how custom chat agents, knowledge spaces, and workplace extensions integrate seamlessly to enhance productivity through natural language interactions across your organization.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Old Mutual Bank: Launching South Africa's Newest Digital Bank at Scale | IND101
additionalFields.bodyBack:
In September 2025, Old Mutual launched OM Bank — a fully digital, cloud-native bank built on AWS via 10x Banking's platform. After a $135M+ investment and nearly a decade of development, OM Bank went live nationwide with a focus on affordability, simplicity, and scale.
The results were immediate: 140,000+ customers in just three months, peaking at 5,000 sign-ups per day, reaching 284,000+ customers by year-end. AWS's elastic infrastructure enabled OM Bank to absorb this rapid growth seamlessly — scaling on demand without compromising security or reliability. The bank is now targeting 2.5–3 million customers by FY2028.

additionalFields.heading: Lightning talk
additionalFields.title: [REPEAT] Your Student Status is Worth More, Build & Earn on Builder | STU105
additionalFields.location: Student Builder Zone UpLink, Hall 2, Floor 0
additionalFields.bodyBack: Learn how to unlock free rewards as a student on AWS Builder Center and get active to earn badges. This session includes a live demo of the sign-up process, walks through the badges you'll complete to earn rewards, and gives you a plan to work towards a free AWS Certification voucher.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Reimagine business intelligence with Amazon Quick Sight | ANT201
additionalFields.bodyBack: Enterprises are transforming with AI-powered BI from Quick Sight, turning scattered data into strategic action. Watch as we demonstrate how Quick Sight eliminates barriers to data-driven decision making using AI agents, allowing everyone to uncover critical insights and achieve better business outcomes. Hear from Cellulant as they share how they transformed their analytics capabilities with Quick Sight—helping users perform advanced data analysis and analyze both structured and unstructured data using AI. Discover how Cellulant is democratizing insights across their organization, analyzing massive high-velocity data sets efficiently, and achieving scalability, all without managing infrastructure.

additionalFields.heading: Lightning talk
additionalFields.title: Your Student Status is Worth More, Build & Earn on Builder Center | STU104
additionalFields.location: Student Builder Zone UpLink, Hall 2, Floor 0
additionalFields.bodyBack: Learn how to unlock free rewards as a student on AWS Builder Center and get active to earn badges. This session includes a live demo of the sign-up process, walks through the badges you'll complete to earn rewards, and gives you a plan to work towards a free AWS Certification voucher.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Lambda Managed Instances: EC2 Power with Serverless Simplicity | CNS301
additionalFields.bodyBack: AWS Lambda Managed Instances enables you to run Lambda functions on your choice of EC2 compute. With Lambda Managed Instances, you can optimize the performance and cost efficiency of your functions by utilizing specialized EC2 instance types and EC2 pricing benefits, while maintaining the familiar Serverless programming model and benefits like automatic patching and scaling. This session will provide an in-depth overview of how to get started with Lambda Managed Instances and a behind-the-scenes look at how Lambda manages and scales your instances to ensure a seamless serverless experience.

additionalFields.heading: Startup talk
additionalFields.title: AI Agents for Fraud: Shop2Shop's Journey on AWS | STP303
additionalFields.bodyBack: Shop2Shop is one of South Africa's fastest-growing FinTechs, processing millions of money transfers across informal retail. As transaction volumes scaled, so did fraud attempts, overwhelming human investigators. CTO Wessel Pieterse and AWS SA Alexis share how Shop2Shop built an agentic fraud detection system on Amazon Bedrock using Strands Agents and AgentCore. The agent performs pre-work for human analysts, enabling the team to handle 3-4x more cases per hour while uncovering previously unknown fraud patterns that feed directly into live detection rules.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Get to know Amazon Quick, your new agentic teammate | AIM204
additionalFields.bodyBack: Most of us spend more time hunting for information than using it. Amazon Quick changes that. It reaches across all your company's data‚ documents, databases, emails, Slack threads, dashboards, Jira tickets and lets you search it, ask questions, and take action, all from one place. Available across web, mobile, Slack, and Microsoft tools with multi-model intelligence, Quick delivers consumer-grade AI with enterprise-grade security and governance. No vendor lock-in, no siloed copilots. Just one AI teammate that works wherever you do.

additionalFields.heading: Startup talk
additionalFields.title: Pick Your Agent Distribution Game | STP302
additionalFields.bodyBack:
The line between your app and the agent is disappearing, and which way you cross it is one of the most important decisions a founder will make this year.
In this session, we’ll explore two emerging patterns turning generative UI into a real go-to-market strategy. First: you own the agent, and customers plug in their own capabilities. Second: you bring your product directly into the AI assistants your users already live in, meeting them at the moment of intent.
Two directions. Two very different distribution games. Two live demos. Come find out which one is yours.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Building a resilient Digital University: UNISA's AWS Transformation | COP201
additionalFields.bodyBack: When ICT system collapses threatened operations at Africa's largest open distance university, UNISA embarked on a bold digital transformation journey with AWS. Hear how the university is modernizing infrastructure to support 400,000+ students, achieving 35% IT cost savings through LMS optimization, and building disaster recovery capabilities that ensure uninterrupted learning. Learn the strategies for navigating complex stakeholder environments and constrained funding while delivering scalable, reliable cloud solutions.

additionalFields.heading: Lightning talk
additionalFields.title: How Old Mutual Transformed AWS Operations with AI Observability (Sponsored by Dynatrace) | PRT202-S
additionalFields.bodyBack: Cloud and AI adoption are accelerating, bringing greater complexity for DevOps, SRE, and platform teams. Join Old Mutual, AWS, and Dynatrace to learn how Old Mutual is transforming cloud operations with AI-powered observability and automation. Discover how Dynatrace and Business Intelligence provide end-to-end visibility across AWS environments, helping teams automatically detect issues, identify root causes, and accelerate resolution. Learn how Old Mutual is improving resilience through automated remediation, preventing service disruptions with proactive operations, and optimizing cloud resources to enhance performance and control costs. Gain practical insights into building more reliable and scalable cloud operations while accelerating innovation on AWS.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Structured Approach to AI coding with Spec-Driven Development on Kiro | TNC204
additionalFields.bodyBack: This session demonstrates how Kiro brings discipline and clarity to AI-assisted software development, ensuring generated code aligns with intended functionality and architecture. Explore Kiro's innovative spec-driven development approach for AI coding. Learn how to leverage structured specifications as a single source of truth, contrasting with unstructured 'vibe coding'. Discover how Kiro uses AI to generate detailed requirements, design, and task documents, guiding AI agents in code creation. Experience a workflow that enhances collaboration, maintainability, and documentation accuracy.

additionalFields.heading: Lightning talk
additionalFields.title: The Human Side of Autonomous IT (sponsored by SolarWinds) | PRT401-S
additionalFields.bodyBack: How Leaders are Redefining Roles in the Age of AI

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Building on AWS resilience: Innovations for critical success | ARC201
additionalFields.bodyBack: Essential services that power global economies and critical infrastructure demand exceptional resilience. Through nearly two decades of focused innovation, AWS has developed core engineering practices and operational approaches that power critical workloads worldwide. Explore how AWS's architectural innovations and organizational practices help customers build robust services that maintain resilience during severe disruptions. Learn how AWS's continued investment in resilience provides the foundation for delivering essential services across governments, economies, and critical infrastructure.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Intelligent Operations (sponsored by Deloitte) | PRT205-S
additionalFields.bodyBack:
Every organisation has the potential to turn insights into meaningful business outcomes. The organisations that excel are those that can act with speed, confidence, and precision. Intelligent Operations bridge the gap between strategic vision and execution, enabling teams to respond proactively and continuously improve performance.
Join Deloitte for a live demonstration of Orbit, an Intelligent Operational Agent built on AWS. Orbit connects digital and physical operational environments to identify issues, uncover root causes, recommend actions, and execute approved resolutions, all within collaboration tools your teams already use, including Microsoft Teams and Slack.
Experience the technology behind running intelligent, agent-powered operations at scale.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Governance that Enables Innovation at Scale feat. Old Mutual | COP301
additionalFields.bodyBack: As enterprises scale their cloud presence, they need flexible, secure environments that adapt to evolving business needs. AWS Control Tower modernizes cloud governance, enabling faster innovation in a secure, resilient manner. Learn how Old Mutual, a pan-African financial services group, migrated to AWS Control Tower with zero downtime for critical workloads. They implemented compliance controls and integrated Account Factory for Terraform to automate provisioning, enhance agility, and strengthen security—allowing them to focus on improving lives and communities.

additionalFields.heading: Lightning talk
additionalFields.title: Building a Company Brain: From Knowledge to Operating Advantage (sponsored by Skywalk Innovations) | PRT301-S
additionalFields.bodyBack: Every company generates valuable knowledge, but much of it remains trapped in documents, meetings, systems, and people’s heads. This session shares Skywalk Innovations’ journey building a secure Company Brain on AWS to transform fragmented information into accessible organisational intelligence. Attendees will learn how we approached knowledge ingestion, metadata, retrieval, permissions, source-grounded responses, and adoption. We will also unpack what worked, what failed, and how connecting the Company Brain to operational workflows is helping us improve decision-making, onboarding, client delivery, and institutional memory.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Agentic AI Meets responsible AI: Strategy and best practices | AIM403
additionalFields.bodyBack: AI agents offer powerful capabilities and require thoughtful design to help manage risks. This session explores responsible agentic AI implementation with appropriate controls and governance. Understand some of the scientific frontiers that inform design considerations, including the language of AI agents, context management, agent interactions, and common sense reasoning. Learn approaches for human oversight, risk mitigation, evaluation methods, and control mechanisms to help align agent behaviors with organizational goals.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Beyond Migration: Absa's Path from Cloud to AI Value Realization | IND202
additionalFields.bodyBack: What happens after your teams are cloud-fluent? Absa answered by evolving its Cloud Guild into an AI skills engine. This session reveals how Absa layered generative AI, ML Ops, and automation upskilling onto existing migration and modernization competencies — scaling across every Line of Business. Learn how the programme connects technical fluency to quantifiable business benefits including reduced time-to-value for AI workloads, operational efficiency gains, and accelerated innovation in Africa's Absa banking group.

additionalFields.heading: Lightning talk
additionalFields.title: Recover up to 100x Faster After a Cyberattack (sponsored by Rubrik) | PRT103-S
additionalFields.bodyBack: AWS provides the world's most robust infrastructure, but in the face of a sophisticated ransomware attack, 'having a backup' isn't the same as 'being back in business.' Relying on manual scripts and siloed snapshots across dozens of accounts creates a recovery gap that can cost weeks of downtime.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Launch Your Cloud Career AI Powered Job Search & Personal Branding | STU205
additionalFields.location: Student Builder Zone Track, Hall 2, Floor 0
additionalFields.bodyBack: Ready to launch your cloud career? This session equips you with AI-powered strategies to accelerate your job search and build a compelling personal brand. You'll learn how to showcase your skills through AWS certifications (from AI Practitioner to Solutions Architect), use agentic AI tools like Kiro to streamline your job applications, and craft a personal brand that is accurate, coherent, compelling, and differentiated.

additionalFields.heading: Exam prep
additionalFields.title: Exam Prep: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate | TNC203
additionalFields.bodyBack: Prepare for the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate exam with this interactive study session. Review the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate Official Practice Question Set, and get your questions answered by the subject matter expert leading the study session.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: What's new with Amazon S3 | STG201
additionalFields.bodyBack: Amazon S3 continually delivers innovations to help you store, manage, analyze, and protect any amount of data for virtually any use case. Discover S3's latest breakthroughs, including S3 Tables enhancements offering fully managed Apache Iceberg support, S3 Vectors with native vector support at scale for AI applications, S3 Metadata for instant data discovery, and S3 Express One Zone's ultra-low latency performance. Learn how these innovations optimize different data types and workloads, boost performance, simplify operations, and lower costs for analytics, AI/ML, and high-performance computing. This session provides implementation strategies, live demonstrations, and practical insights to immediately optimize your data architecture.

additionalFields.heading: Workshop
additionalFields.title: Build Autonomous AI Agents: The Agentic Football Cup Challenge | STU204
additionalFields.location: Student Builder Zone Workshop, Hall 2, Floor 0
additionalFields.bodyBack: Build Autonomous AI Agents: The Agentic Football Cup Challenge

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Build production AI agents with the Strands Agents SDK for TypeScript | AIM309
additionalFields.bodyBack: Discover how to build enterprise-ready AI agents using the newly launched Strands Agents SDK for TypeScript. This session introduces developers to a simple model-driven framework for building agents that run on any cloud, support multiple LLM providers, and integrate with the tools you already have. Learn how TypeScript developers can now leverage the same production-ready agent framework that Python teams have been using, with full type safety and seamless integration into modern JavaScript ecosystems.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: AWS Security Agent: Proactive AppSec From Design to Deployment | SEC303
additionalFields.bodyBack: Application security teams face an impossible challenge: scale security expertise across growing application portfolios while maintaining development velocity. Traditional approaches force organizations to choose between speed and security. In this session, discover how AWS Security Agent transforms application security from reactive to proactive through AI-powered automation. Learn how this frontier agent conducts automated security reviews customized to your organizational requirements and delivers on-demand penetration testing tailored to your applications. Join us to see how you can scale security coverage and prevent vulnerabilities early in the development lifecycle while maintaining the speed of modern development.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: AI and Creative Thinking in System Design for Tech Student Startups | STU202
additionalFields.location: Student Builder Zone Track, Hall 2, Floor 0
additionalFields.bodyBack: You have a great startup idea, but how do you turn it into a working system? This session shows tech students how to use AI as a creative thinking partner and a system design accelerator

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: How Standard Bank built an AI-ready data foundation | ANT302
additionalFields.bodyBack: Standard Bank Group, Africa’s largest bank by assets, shares how they modernized their enterprise data platform on AWS. Learn how they implemented Amazon SageMaker Unified Studio to unify data cataloging, quality monitoring, and fine-grained access control across the organization. Discover the architectural patterns for operating a governed data mesh at scale. This session covers the migration decision framework, lessons learned, and how this foundation now powers their AI and ML initiatives.

additionalFields.heading: Keynote
additionalFields.title: Keynote | KEY101
additionalFields.bodyBack: At AWS, we believe builders should have the freedom to invent anything. Today, AI agents are transforming what's possible. Join us to learn how AWS makes it easier than ever to build, deploy, and scale agents. Hear from customers achieving breakthroughs by migrating workloads to the cloud and integrating AI into their operations. Discover where agents are heading, and how AWS is removing every barrier between your imagination and reality

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Using Tools and Agents in Generative AI applications | TNC301
additionalFields.bodyBack: Join us for an engaging session on AI Agents and Tools in AWS, where we’ll explore how to build intelligent, autonomous systems using Amazon Bedrock and open-source frameworks. Learn about function calling, ReAct patterns, and AWS’s comprehensive agent platforms. We’ll dive into practical demonstrations using Strands and CrewAI, and discover how to leverage protocols like MCP and A2A for seamless tool integration and agent collaboration. Perfect for developers looking to create production-ready AI solutions.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Why Get AWS Certified? | STU101
additionalFields.location: Student Builder Zone Track, Hall 2, Floor 0
additionalFields.bodyBack: You’ll learn about the advantages of getting AWS Certified. You’ll also learn about the various certifications offered by AWS and what the AWS Skills Centers and other AWS programs have available to help you prepare to take these certification exams.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: From Application Sprawl to Strategic Advantage: The SPECTR Approach (sponsored by iOCO Technology) | PRT102-S
additionalFields.bodyBack: Most organisations know they need to modernise their applications, but the challenge is knowing where to start, what it will cost, and whether the investment will deliver business value. Legacy systems are often poorly documented, costly to maintain, and risky to change, making modernisation decisions slow and difficult to defend at board level. SPECTR, developed by iOCO, uses artificial intelligence to transform complex application estates into clear business insight. It identifies risk and cost drivers, prioritises applications, and builds a practical modernisation roadmap, supported by a portfolio-level business case covering investment, effort, returns, payback periods, and potential savings. Move from uncertainty to confident transformation.

additionalFields.heading: Dev chat
additionalFields.title: Use agent strategies to streamline complex business tasks | DEV301
additionalFields.bodyBack: Complex business tasks don't have to be manual. In this talk, we build a memory-powered, multi-agent financial advisor using the open-source Strands SDK complete with custom tools, multi-agent orchestration, and Amazon Bedrock Guardrails for responsible AI. Then we deploy it live to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime. Walk away with practical agent strategies you can apply immediately to automate and streamline complex workflows in your own business context no fluff, just working code.

additionalFields.heading: Chalk talk
additionalFields.title: Unlock New Business by Removing Data Silos with Zero-Copy | MAM304
additionalFields.bodyBack: Enterprises need to unify fragmented data to accelerate launch of AI applications, where some data reside in their AWS environments and some in their accounts in SaaS platforms. Many leading ISVs are partnering with AWS to solve this challenge for their customers by building Zero-Copy data federation between their SaaS platforms and end customers. AWS data stores. Join us to explore how you can build such solutions leveraging lakehouse architecture of Amazon SageMaker, Amazon S3, AWS Glue, AWS Lake Formation, Amazon Redshift, and Apache Iceberg, while maintaining governance and real-time synchronization.

additionalFields.heading: Chalk talk
additionalFields.title: Securing Agentic AI: OWASP, MAESTRO, and Real-World Defense Strategies | SEC301
additionalFields.bodyBack: Explore the latest in Agentic AI security with OWASP's updated Threats and Mitigations Guide and Agentic Security Initiative. We will also explore MAESTRO, a specialized threat modeling approach for AI systems, offering a layered methodology to identify and mitigate risks throughout the AI lifecycle. Through a real-world case study, we'll demonstrate security best practices for agentic AI, including robust governance, continuous monitoring, and least-privilege access. Learn how to confidently deploy autonomous AI agents while minimizing risks. Gain practical insights for building secure, trustworthy, and resilient agentic AI applications that can transform industries safely.

additionalFields.heading: Chalk talk
additionalFields.title: Put your data to work for Agentic AI with AWS storage | STG202
additionalFields.bodyBack: Agentic AI systems require storage delivering persistent memory, real-time decisions, and seamless multi-agent collaboration. AWS offers the most comprehensive storage portfolio to support these needs, including high-speed services like S3 Express One Zone, storage for compute intensive agent workflows using FSx for Lustre, scalable vector storage and query with S3 Vectors. With the new MCP Server for S3, agents can query context-rich data using natural language without complex code. Explore how to architect agentic AI with purpose-built AWS storage and integrations with Amazon Bedrock and OpenSearch Service, enabling intelligent agents to operate continuously while simplifying infrastructure and accelerating production deployment.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Building software like never before with agentic AI | DVT201
additionalFields.bodyBack: Discover the future of software development as we explore the transformative power of agents with Kiro’s spec-driven development in modernizing your entire software development lifecycle (SDLC). Agentic AI is impacting software development by automating tasks, improving efficiency, and enabling more autonomous workflows throughout the development lifecycle. It allows teams to go beyond simple code generation to handle project planning, designing, testing, documentation, building agents into workflows, and retiring technical debt. Join us to explore how these powerful capabilities work together to help organizations accelerate from prototype to production ready applications.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: New Horizons | SAP201
additionalFields.bodyBack: Our Cloud Journey, Lessons in Transformation, and What We Discovered Along the Way

additionalFields.heading: Lightning talk
additionalFields.title: Building a Cloud Career: What I Wish I Knew When I Started | STU109
additionalFields.location: Student Builder Zone UpLink, Hall 2, Floor 0
additionalFields.bodyBack: Most students focus on learning technology, but few know how to navigate the opportunities that exist across the cloud industry. In this session, I’ll share my journey, the lessons I learned, and the decisions that shaped my career in AWS. We’ll discuss the skills, mindset, and experiences that helped me grow, and how you can apply them to build your own successful career in cloud

additionalFields.heading: Chalk talk
additionalFields.title: Building AI for millions of students at national scale | IND401
additionalFields.bodyBack: Ready to explore prompting engineering at unprecedented scale? Discover how Brazil's Ministry of Education (MEC) leveraged AWS AI services to revolutionize education access for millions of students nationwide. This technical chalk talk reveals the strategies behind building and deploying an AI-powered educational platform from concept to national implementation. You will see advanced prompting engineering techniques, scalable AI frameworks, and proven methodologies for measuring and iterating prompts in production environments. Learn from one of the world's largest educational AI deployments and walk away with actionable strategies for scaling your own.

additionalFields.heading: Startup talk
additionalFields.title: Bridging from POC to production: An intro to Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | STP203
additionalFields.bodyBack: Going from a pilot to a secure, scalable, and reliable agent system requires more than great prompts. In session, we'll show how Amazon Bedrock AgentCore helps teams move from proof-of-concept to production using enterprise-grade services, including Runtime, Gateway, Identity, Memory, Observability, Registry, Payments, Policy, Evaluations, Code Interpreter, and Browser. Learn how these capabilities simplify development, reduce operational burden, and improve time-to-value. We'll go over the best practices and cover foundational capabilities like enterprise readiness, tool integration, and performance at scale, providing a blueprint for success no matter where you are in your journey.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Accelerate Data Migrations to AWS: Africa's Largest Payment Migration | IND203
additionalFields.bodyBack: Cloud Acceleration Migration Acceleration Program achieved Africa's most ambitious cloud transformation, migrating 100+ mission-critical workloads including EFT, Real-Time Clearing, and SADC RTGS to AWS in 16 months, 8 months ahead of schedule. The migration encompassed 1000+ cloud resources, 700+ servers, and a 150TB data warehouse transformed into a 20.6TB data lake (145% reduction). With 260+ stakeholders coordinated across eight domains, CMAP processed 184 billion transactions while maintaining zero security incidents and full regulatory compliance. This session demonstrates enterprise-scale migration excellence, achieving 40% infrastructure efficiency gains while positioning PayInc as Africa's continental leader in digital payments modernization through strategic cloud adoption.

additionalFields.heading: Workshop
additionalFields.title: Build a solution using natural language and AI. No coding required | STU108
additionalFields.location: Student Builder Zone Workshop, Hall 2, Floor 0
additionalFields.bodyBack: PartyRock hackathon, a hands-on AI fluency experience where attendees build a working AI-powered solution to a real-world problem using only natural language. No coding, no AWS account, no setup required. Participants join via a QR code, describe their solution, and watch it come to life in their browser within minutes.

additionalFields.heading: Builders' session
additionalFields.title: Power streaming analytics on AWS with AI-driven insights | ANT307
additionalFields.bodyBack: In this Builders' session, build modern streaming analytics with agentic AI to analyze events and extract patterns.

additionalFields.heading: Builders' session
additionalFields.title: Modernize applications with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Strands, & MCP | DVT401
additionalFields.bodyBack: Architect and implement AI into existing apps via event-driven architectures, data pipelines for RAG, and MCP servers

additionalFields.heading: Lightning talk
additionalFields.title: Turning a Portfolio Project Into a Story | STU107
additionalFields.location: Student Builder Zone UpLink, Hall 2, Floor 0
additionalFields.bodyBack: You’ve built the project. Now, how do you make sure it actually gets you noticed? This session picks up where “Building Your First Cloud Portfolio Project” leaves off, focusing on the one skill most students overlook: turning technical work into a compelling story. Using a simple Problem → Solution → Impact framework, you’ll learn why recruiters skim CVs in seconds, why “I used AWS” means nothing without context, and how small wording changes transform a forgettable project into an interview-worthy one.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: From demo to deployment: solving agentic AI's toughest challenges | AIM203
additionalFields.bodyBack: Most AI agent projects stall when moving from prototype to production. This session tackles the top challenges builders face when deploying agentic AI at scale. You'll learn how to answer the fundamental question of whether to build custom agents or leverage pre-built agents for DevOps, security, development, and business productivity use cases. Then you'll discover how to address the critical production challenges of reliability, observability, cost management, security, and evaluation. Drawing from real customer deployments and AWS's portfolio of agentic AI capabilities, you'll gain actionable approaches for building agents that don't just demo well but ship and scale.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Connect Agents: Tool Integration & Access with AgentCore | AIM306
additionalFields.bodyBack: Unlock AI agent potential with this advanced session on scaling tools using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway. Learn to build and manage secure, production-ready agent tool environments. We'll cover multi-tenant architecture, deployment strategies, and integration patterns for agentic tools. Explore zero-code MCP tool creation with intelligent tool discovery.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: How Peach Payments built a scalable payments engine on AWS | CMP304
additionalFields.bodyBack: ISVs building payment platforms must balance control over transaction routing with the ability to scale reliably across markets. This session explores how Peach Payments architected a self-hosted deployment of Hyperswitch, an open-source payments orchestration engine, alongside a proprietary Java-based payment rail on AWS. Attendees learn the architecture decisions spanning compute, networking, and data layers that enable Peach Payments to process growing transaction volumes across Africa while maintaining low latency and high availability, and walk away with practical patterns for deploying complex open-source platforms on AWS infrastructure.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Prompt Battle Arena: Score Your AI Skills Live | STU201
additionalFields.location: Student Builder Zone Track, Hall 2, Floor 0
additionalFields.bodyBack: Think prompting AI is just typing a question? Think again. In this high-energy, hands-on session, you'll learn that prompt engineering is a measurable skill, and then prove it in a live competition against your peers.

additionalFields.heading: Builders' session
additionalFields.title: Building Event-driven Architectures | ARC305
additionalFields.bodyBack: In this Builders' session, learn event-driven design using SNS, SQS, Lambda, EventBridge for decoupled services.

additionalFields.heading: Meetup
additionalFields.title: Color-Coded tokens turn strangers into new connections | WOC001
additionalFields.location: Women of the Cloud, Expo Restaurant, Floor -1
additionalFields.bodyBack: We've all sat with the same colleagues we see every day. Networks stay closed, newcomers feel like outsiders, and the best conversations never happen. At the Women of the Cloud Networking event, we're changing that. Grab a color token at the door, your color is your table, a deliberate mix of women across roles, companies, and experience levels. No cliques, no awkward "where do I sit?" moment. Simple icebreakers spark the conversation, and a quick QR scan connects you to your Color Council LinkedIn Group so the relationships last. Come for the sessions. Leave with new connections.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Hassle-free multicloud connectivity with AWS Interconnect | CDN201
additionalFields.bodyBack: Many organizations choose AWS as their primary cloud, building their core network, security, and operations around it—while still needing to connect to other Cloud Service Providers (CSPs). In this session, discover AWS Direct Connect Multicloud Connectivity, a new capability that lets you leverage AWS as your unified control point for cross-cloud connectivity. Learn to extend AWS Transit Gateway and AWS Cloud WAN across clouds using managed Direct Connect connections, without relying on third-party providers or physical presence in colocation facilities. We'll showcase reference architectures for multicloud inspection, shared services, and routing policy enforcement.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Agents in the enterprise: Best practices with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | AIM305
additionalFields.bodyBack: As organizations scale AI agent development, robust enterprise architecture patterns become essential. Amazon Bedrock AgentCore enables teams to build modular agentic systems using preferred frameworks while sharing tools through MCP gateways. Old Mutual, Africa's largest pan-African financial services group, built Plato: a system that gives AI agents context to understand code ownership, team connections, and dependencies. By mapping people, squads, and applications into a connected graph, Plato detects cross-team impact from code changes, proposes fixes beyond single repositories, and resolves conflicting information using confidence-based hierarchy. The result: fewer failed releases, less planning overhead, and fewer expert interruptions.

additionalFields.heading: Lightning talk
additionalFields.title: Recruitment Fireside Chat: What Makes a Successful Intern & Grad | STU102
additionalFields.location: Student Builder Zone UpLink, Hall 2, Floor 0
additionalFields.bodyBack:
Hear directly from a Software Development Manager on what sets high-performing interns and graduates apart; from demonstrating curiosity and ownership, to unblocking challenges by asking the right questions, engaging with your team, and making meaningful impact on real projects. 

Leave with a clear understanding of the skills, behaviours, and mindset you should display to make the most of your internship opportunity.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: What No One Tells You When You Start Your Cloud Journey | STU203
additionalFields.location: Student Builder Zone Track, Hall 2, Floor 0
additionalFields.bodyBack: AI is the headline, but networking, storage, databases, and compute are the foundation. This session covers the cloud fundamentals every builder needs to actually ship real applications on AWS.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: The AI-Ready Enterprise: A CTO's Blueprint for Modernizing the Estate (sponsored by Concierto by Trianz) | PRT302-S
additionalFields.bodyBack:
Turning the estate you have into a foundation that AI can actually run on. 
Every enterprise has an AI mandate. Few have an estate ready to deliver on it. Most enterprise AI never leaves the pilot - the real barrier is the estate: fragmented data, legacy backends, and weak governance. This session reframes AI-readiness as something you build, not buy. The real unlock is modernizing the estate you already have. Attendees learn a practical CTO blueprint: modernizing legacy backends with AI in the loop, adding conversational experiences, and governing data fit for AI - wherever you are on your journey.

additionalFields.heading: Dev chat
additionalFields.title: Blocks 101 | DEV202
additionalFields.bodyBack: More information coming soon.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Absa's FinOps as a Strategic Enabler for Cloud Migration at Scale | MAM203
additionalFields.bodyBack: This session unpacks a transformation journey, how FinOps was established as a strategic enabler to bring large-scale cloud migrations into a controlled, scalable operating environment. It explores how fragmented processes evolved into a data-driven model that embeds financial accountability into engineering and migration decisions, without slowing delivery. The focus is on scaling FinOps beyond cost visibility into a core capability that governs workload migration at pace. Looking ahead, it highlights the shift toward AI and automation, moving from reactive insights to proactive, self-optimising environments that continuously manage cost, usage, and value in real time.

additionalFields.heading: Workshop
additionalFields.title: Building an Enterprise Agentic AI Platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore | AIM301
additionalFields.bodyBack: Without agentic AI governance, teams deploy MCP servers with no inventory, agents hardcode tool endpoints, and no unified identity or audit trail connects agents to tool invocations. In this workshop you build: an LLM Gateway for unified model access, an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Registry to catalog MCP servers and A2A agent cards with group-based access control and scoped service accounts, and an Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway that enforces content screening and logs every tool call.

additionalFields.heading: Dev chat
additionalFields.title: Kiro: The AI Teammate That Doesn’t Break Prod | DEV203
additionalFields.bodyBack:
We’ve all seen shiny AI demos on new repos with perfect prompts. Everything works first time. No edge cases, no legacy code, no Friday deployments. That’s not real life.
Most of us deal with systems that have history. Old code nobody wants to touch. Tests that mostly exist in spirit. Production that doesn’t like experimentation.
I’ll show how I use Kiro as a working engineer, not a demo tool. We’ll cover messy code, useful tests, safe refactoring, and moving faster without breaking prod at 4:59pm on Friday.
No hype. Just practical lessons from someone who double-checks before merging.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Modernize SQL Server & .NET Together with AWS Transform's New AI Agent | DAT308
additionalFields.bodyBack: Want to cut your Microsoft licensing costs by up to 70% while modernizing SQL Server workloads? Join us to explore AWS Transform's groundbreaking new capability that automates end-to-end migration from SQL Server to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL. Learn how this powerful solution converts your entire SQL Server stack - from schemas and stored procedures to embedded logic - while accelerating modernization timelines by up to 5x. In this session, we'll demonstrate how AWS Transform helps you achieve enhanced security, performance, and scalability through purpose-built AWS services, revolutionizing your database modernization journey.

additionalFields.heading: Gamified learning
additionalFields.title: Secret Agent(ic) Unicorn GameDay | DVT302
additionalFields.bodyBack: Can your team build a production-ready AI agent before the clock runs out? Secret Agent(ic) Unicorn is a gamified, team-based challenge where you go hands-on with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and the open-source Strands Agents SDK to design, build, and deploy autonomous agents that solve real business problems. No step-by-step guide, just a live sandbox, a scoreboard, and your team's ingenuity. You will wire up tools, reasoning, and guardrails, then watch your agents compete. Expect fast feedback, friendly competition, and practical patterns you can take straight back to production. Developers of all backgrounds welcome; bring curiosity, leave with agentic skills.

additionalFields.heading: Workshop
additionalFields.title: Multi-Agent AI Solution with Amazon Aurora & Bedrock AgentCore | DAT401
additionalFields.bodyBack: Multi-agent collaboration unlocks new levels of reasoning, specialization, and task orchestration in generative AI systems. In this hands-on workshop, learn how to harness Model Context Protocol (MCP) with AWS agentic AI services and Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition to build a collaborative AI system. You’ll create specialized agents focused on data interaction use cases that demonstrate a variety of data retrieval, analysis, or decision-making tasks grounded in real-time data and context from Aurora. Build a working prototype that showcases how intelligent agents can collaborate to solve complex problems with grounded enterprise data. You must bring your laptop to participate.

additionalFields.heading: Chalk talk
additionalFields.title: AWS Backup Insights at Scale with Amazon Quick | STG301
additionalFields.bodyBack: Managing AWS Backup across an organization generates vast operational data that often goes underutilized. This chalk talk explores how to transform organization-wide AWS Backup reports — stored as CSV files in Amazon S3 — into interactive visual dashboards using Amazon Quick. Attendees will learn how to configure AWS Backup Audit Manager reports, connect them to Quick via S3 manifests, and build dashboards that surface backup compliance status, job success rates, and storage consumption across resource types and accounts — turning raw backup telemetry into actionable insights that drive better governance and cost optimization.

additionalFields.heading: Chalk talk
additionalFields.title: AWS Networking Fundamentals: Connect, secure and scale | CDN202
additionalFields.bodyBack: Dive into AWS networking foundations, starting with the fundamentals of Amazon VPC in a single Region. Learn essential skills for IPv4 and IPv6 selection, subnetting, routing, DNS, and security before scaling to global, multi-Region architectures. In this session, explore various VPC connectivity methods, hybrid network integration, and secure traffic management techniques. Discover how to implement private remote access for cloud resources and optimize service-to-service communication while building zero trust architectures. Whether new to AWS or wanting to expand networking building blocks, this session delivers practical insights into best practices and proven architecture patterns for establishing global connectivity.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Spending Smarter on Analytics: From Framework to Live Implementation | ANT202
additionalFields.bodyBack: In this session, Kennedy Masunda (AWS) and Theo Groenewald (Discovery Group) walk through the principles and AWS tooling for establishing cost governance across environments. Kennedy covers the framework: policies, automation levers, and native AWS controls that enforce spending discipline without slowing engineering teams. Theo then shares how his Data Management team at Discovery is applying these patterns to their AWS-based data lake. The approach they are following, what they're changing and how they are  measuring.  This is not a retrospective case study; it's a live implementation in progress, presented with the practical detail needed to replicate it.

additionalFields.heading: Workshop
additionalFields.title: Modernize your contact center agent workspace with Amazon Connect | BIZ301
additionalFields.bodyBack: Amazon Connect customers in South Africa are currently underutilizing their agent workspace. This will show customers how they can leverage the Agent workspace SDK to modernize and unlock the art of the possible.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Building autonomous GenAI at scale with Amazon Bedrock | AIM201
additionalFields.bodyBack: Amazon Bedrock empowers organisations to rapidly prototype autonomous applications and agents, seamlessly scaling from proof-of-concept to production. In this session, hear from The Unlimited Child, a South African social enterprise that built a first-of-its-kind generative AI coaching app on Bedrock AI, putting an expert in the pocket of 15,000 ECD practitioners across Africa. Learn how they scaled from MVP to production, delivering real-time guidance on early childhood development while lifting cognitive load from frontline workers.

additionalFields.heading: Lightning talk
additionalFields.title: The Power of  Using The Right Skills For The Job  (sponsored by Tati Software) | PRT303-S
additionalFields.bodyBack: Moving more than 300,000 user records across cloud platforms is not a simple lift-and-shift when architectures, data models, and security requirements differ. Join Tati Software to learn how it migrated its MobileGPT product from a monolithic DigitalOcean environment to an AWS microservices architecture. Explore an event-driven ETL approach using Amazon S3, AWS Step Functions, and Amazon ECS, and gain practical guidance on secure data transfer, automated transformation and validation, audit reporting, observability, on-demand compute, and temporary infrastructure that can be removed after migration.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: MedZenHealth across Africa on AWS | CMP303
additionalFields.bodyBack: Healthcare software companies must deliver virtual care and digital innovation while protecting patient data across markets. MylesTech built MedZenHealth, a connected-care platform that follows the patient from booking and consultation through facility operations and at-home recovery, and now runs in production in Cameroon. This session examines how the team uses Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to run agentic, human-in-the-loop clinical workflows in which the platform drafts documentation while clinicians retain control, and how its architecture supports regional expansion.

additionalFields.heading: Chalk talk
additionalFields.title: Inside AWS: Building what's new while everything changes | AIM101
additionalFields.bodyBack: AI isn't just changing how we write code, it's transforming how we run businesses, build platforms, measure success, and make engineering decisions at scale. From inside AWS, where teams are actively shaping the cloud that powers modern AI, this session shares a real-world perspective on navigating rapid change: redefining productivity, making smart tool choices, and building the judgment needed to lead through ambiguity. This is an open/collaborative conversation with a live demo using Kiro to start you on your exploration journey.

additionalFields.heading: Workshop
additionalFields.title: Build an agentic full-stack tabletop game master application | DEV304
additionalFields.bodyBack:
We've run AI-powered tabletop game master sessions at conferences where audiences became the adventuring party. They loved it. Now learn to build the whole thing yourself. You'll start with a pre-built UI and mock data, then turn it into a full-stack application with real-time multiplayer and an AI game master that narrates encounters, controls enemies, and responds to players.
You'll build authentication, persistent game state, real-time sync, an agentic game master with memory, AI-generated actions, AI players, and storage for character portraits and map assets. By the end you'll have a running application with real-time combat, narrative, and dice rolls.

additionalFields.heading: Dev chat
additionalFields.title: AWS Security Agent for Autonomous Threat Response | DEV204
additionalFields.bodyBack:
Security teams are stuck in alert fatigue while threats move faster. Traditional tools just detect and alert, creating thousands of false positives that slow response times. AWS Security Agent changes this by investigating threats, validating vulnerabilities, and responding autonomously.

This session shows how to adopt AWS Security Agent in your security operations. You'll see its multi-agent architecture, learn to integrate it with existing workflows using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, and implement proper security controls through IAM, Guardrails, and PrivateLink. We'll cover the Agentic AI Security Scoping Matrix for risk assessment and practical patterns for deploying autonomous security without creating new vulnerabilities.

additionalFields.heading: Gamified learning
additionalFields.title: Secret Agent(ic) Unicorn GameDay | DVT301
additionalFields.bodyBack: Can your team build a production-ready AI agent before the clock runs out? Secret Agent(ic) Unicorn is a gamified, team-based challenge where you go hands-on with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and the open-source Strands Agents SDK to design, build, and deploy autonomous agents that solve real business problems. No step-by-step guide, just a live sandbox, a scoreboard, and your team's ingenuity. You will wire up tools, reasoning, and guardrails, then watch your agents compete. Expect fast feedback, friendly competition, and practical patterns you can take straight back to production. Developers of all backgrounds welcome; bring curiosity, leave with agentic skills.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Beyond Golden Signals: Monitoring in the Age of GenAI (Sponsored by Datadog) | PRT204-S
additionalFields.bodyBack: The four golden signals (Latency, Errors, Traffic, Saturation) have long been the foundation of application monitoring, but they alone create new blind spots in GenAI apps. Responses can still hallucinate, leak PII, or exceed cost expectations. This talk explores three additional dimensions - Cost, Safety and Quality - and why each is critical when instrumenting non-deterministic, token-priced, prompt-injectable systems.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: How BMW ZA is using Serverless for Option Take Rate Planning | IND201
additionalFields.bodyBack: Explore how BMW ZA is using serverless services and machine learning to do Option Take Rate Planning. The application helps the company to save millions in revenue by accurately planning the take rate per cars per material price.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Women Driving Africa's Future of Work with Cloud, AI & Automation | WOC101
additionalFields.body: Speakers: Standard Bank, Standard Bank Group, OM Bank, AWS
additionalFields.location: Women of the Cloud, Expo Restaurant, Floor -1
additionalFields.bodyBack: Across Africa, women are reshaping how work gets done. Join this fireside chat with inspiring women leaders driving digital transformation through cloud, AI, and automation. Hear candid stories of the breakthroughs and challenges behind real innovation, discover how emerging technology is transforming organizations and communities, and take away practical insights for scaling change across the continent. This is a forward-looking conversation on building inclusive digital economies, growing tech talent, and shaping the future of work. Whether you're a leader, technologist, or aspiring changemaker, you'll leave inspired to drive transformation in your own world.

additionalFields.heading: Builders' session
additionalFields.title: Design authentication & authorization logic for Agentic AI apps | SEC304
additionalFields.bodyBack: In this Builders' session, implement user and machine authentication with fine-grained authorization for AI agents using Strands SDK, AgentCore Identity, Cognito, and Verified Permissions.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: A practitioner’s guide to data for agentic AI | ANT303
additionalFields.bodyBack: In this session, gain the skills needed to deploy end-to-end agentic AI applications using your most valuable data. This session focuses on data management using processes like Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), and provides concepts that apply to other methods of customizing agentic AI applications. Discover best practice architectures using AWS database services like Amazon Aurora and OpenSearch Service, along with analytical, data processing and streaming experiences found in SageMaker Unified Studio. Learn data lake, governance, and data quality concepts and how Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and other features tie solution components together.

additionalFields.heading: Lightning talk
additionalFields.title: Recruitment Fireside Chat: An Intern's Perspective | STU103
additionalFields.location: Student Builder Zone UpLink, Hall 2, Floor 0
additionalFields.bodyBack: Hear from a successful intern/graduate as they share their journey; from navigating the recruitment process, to delivering a real project that enabled their team. They'll discuss what the project involved, how they tackled challenges, completed key deliverables, and what they learned along the way about the culture, collaboration, and growth opportunities available to them.

additionalFields.heading: Exam prep
additionalFields.title: Exam Prep: AWS Certified AI Practitioner | TNC101
additionalFields.bodyBack: Prepare for the AWS Certified AI Practitioner exam with this study session. Review questions from the official practice question set. Ask questions of the subject matter expert leading the study session. Continue preparing for your exam with confidence following the four-step plan on AWS Skill Builder.

additionalFields.heading: Roundtable
additionalFields.body: Speakers: AfriGIS, Entersekt, Clickatell, Electrum Software, AWS
additionalFields.title: AI-native from South Africa: How ISVs win on the global stage | ISV201
additionalFields.location: Women of the Cloud, Expo Restaurant, Floor -1
additionalFields.bodyBack: The global software industry is being reshaped by agentic AI. The AWS Software Company Competitiveness Index 2025, surveying 775 senior software leaders, shows that 79% of European ISVs report rising customer expectations around AI functionality and 71% cite AI integration as their top innovation priority. But what does this transformation look like from South Africa? This fireside chat explores how five leading ISVs building from and for South Africa, while competing globally, navigate the shift to AI-native software. Turning regional realities into global competitive advantages.

additionalFields.heading: Startup talk
additionalFields.title: Red Team vs Blue Team - Securing AI Agents | STP201
additionalFields.bodyBack: AI agents represent the next evolution of APIs, bringing new security challenges and attack vectors. This session examines real-world adversarial threats including prompt injection, tool abuse, and agent-to-agent escalation. Learn defensive strategies using rate limiting, encrypted endpoints, and Amazon Bedrock Guardrails. The session demonstrates how to build secure-by-default agents using Infrastructure as Code, enforcing deterministic behavior and Zero Trust principles. Essential knowledge for teams deploying autonomous agents in production environments.

additionalFields.heading: Breakout session
additionalFields.title: Resilient Cloud Ops: AI-Powered Frontline Care on AWS | COP304
additionalFields.bodyBack: Healthcare platforms in developing markets demand uncompromising resiliency — downtime isn't an option when frontline workers depend on AI-assisted screening. Yet donor-funded programmes face constant cost constraints requiring operational excellence in cloud management. We share how Palladium Group, running AI-powered clinical tools across Nigeria and Kenya on AWS, transformed their cloud operations from reactive monitoring to proactive, AI-assisted cost and resiliency management. The journey began with a tagging strategy for donor attribution, followed by operational dashboards, anomaly detection, and engineer upskilling with Kiro and MCP servers for right-sizing — ensuring their patient and medical facilities support tools scale cost-effectively across sub-Saharan Africa.
